C0969.title: Automated AFK Scripts Undermining Online Game Fairness
C0969.summary: In September 2015, Lu and others agreed with Zhang to use plug-in software to farm and sell virtual currency from an online game. Zhang installed the plug-in on 270 computers purchased by Lu's group and controlled them remotely, automatically logging into large numbers of game accounts to complete tasks, collect virtual currency and items, and sell them for profit. The group illegally earned more than 744,000 yuan, showing how automated AFK scripts undermine game fairness, virtual-economy order, and normal platform operations.
